## Contracts A/B/C landed 17:52

- `app/content/taxonomy.json` (Contract A): 25 nodes, `key`/`slug`/`scope`/`parent`/`order`/`skus`/`image_sku`, matching conductor §4 verbatim (10 type roots, 5 protein children, 4 utility, 6 goals). SKU membership: type/utility leaf-or-root skus from the catalogue CSV's `categories` column (`docs/build/research/optimalx-catalogue.csv`); `protein`'s skus are the union of its five children's (parent expansion, matching `categories.ts`'s existing behaviour); goal skus copied from `app/content/goals.ts` (`goal-ideal-weight` = the union of its two groups via the same logic as `goalSkus()`).
- `app/content/taxonomy.ts` (Contract B): `TaxonomyNode`, `TAXONOMY`, `nodeBySlug`, `childrenOf`, `MENU`. For the 21 nodes already covered by `categories.ts`/`goals.ts`, `h1Key`/`titleKey`/`introKey`/`faq`/`icon` point at their existing keys (no duplication). The 4 utility nodes (bundles, services, digital-library, gift-cards) get a full new set under `ox.tax.<key>.*`. Every node gets a new `nameKey`/`descriptionKey` under `ox.tax.<key>.name` / `.description`.
- `app/content/categories.ts`, `app/content/goals.ts`: gained `nameKey`/`descriptionKey` fields per Contract B, pointing at the same `ox.tax.*` keys `taxonomy.ts` computes, so both stay in sync by construction.
- `locales/partials/tax.ar.json`, `tax.en.json`: 86 keys each. All 25 nodes: `name` (short label) + `description` (Arabic 120-155 chars, verified by `tests/content/taxonomy.test.ts`; English similarly bounded). The 4 utility nodes additionally: `h1`, `title`, `intro`, `faq_1..3_q/a`. Sourced from `docs/build/research/keywords-ar.md` §2 (C01-C11, C15, C20, C22, C26, C27 for names; head queries and members informed the descriptions) and §6 (EN twins) for the 21 covered nodes; hand-written, claims-checked copy for the 4 utility nodes (no cluster exists for them in the research — they are store-utility pages, not search-driven). No "بأفضل سعر" anywhere in new copy (conductor §0/§5 decision: "أصلي في السعودية" pattern instead).
- `app/content/taxonomy-ids.ts` (generated, empty until S5 runs) + `scripts/gen-taxonomy-ids.mjs` (mirrors `gen-salla-ids.mjs`). Not wired into `package.json` (S7's job per the shared-file conflicts table); run directly with `node scripts/gen-taxonomy-ids.mjs`.
- `app/components/listing/useTaxonomyLinks.ts` (Contract C): resolves every taxonomy slug through the live category list (`category.queries.list()`, flattened via `sub_categories`, matched by id from `taxonomy-ids.ts` or by slug) → the dashboard menu (`menu.queries.header()`) → a search fallback. Returns `{ types, goals, utility, bySlug, isLoading }`.
- Consolidated the three duplicate `pathSegments`/`matchesSlug` implementations into one export in `app/components/listing/resolve.ts`; `useHeaderMenu.ts` and `useTaxonomyLinks.ts` import it and `useHeaderMenu.ts` re-exports it (existing imports/tests of `matchesSlug`/`pathSegments` from that module keep working unchanged).
- `useHeaderMenu()` and `useSlugLink()` are now thin adapters over `useTaxonomyLinks()`; their public shapes are unchanged, so every existing consumer (`OxGoals`, `SubNeeds`, `ZeroResults`, `OxCategories`) keeps working without a call-site change.
- Tests: `tests/content/taxonomy.test.ts` (new) — 25 nodes/order, protein nesting, 5 key kinds resolve ar+en, Arabic description length 120-155, SKU membership (every catalogue SKU in exactly one type leaf-or-root, protein root carries every child SKU, every utility SKU in exactly one utility node). `tests/content/maps.test.ts` updated: the "key outside ox.content" assertion now allows the new `ox.tax.*` keys `categories.ts`/`goals.ts` legitimately reference.
- Verified: `pnpm vitest run tests/content` → 3 files, 70 tests passed (includes the new taxonomy test, 8/8).

## Steps 3-4 done 18:02

- `app/content/nav.ts`: `HEADER_NAV` is five items (المنتجات mega panel, المكملات types dropdown, البروتين + its five children, اسأل قبل أن تشتري plain link, المزيد utility+pages dropdown); `meal-plans` and the trailing `about-brand` are gone (`about-brand` moved into `SECONDARY_NAV`, conductor §5 decision). `FOOTER_COLUMNS` products column reads `MENU.types` top four (protein, creatine, pre-workout, amino-acids) instead of the old `supplements`/`meal-plans` slugs.
- `app/components/layout/Header/MegaPanel.tsx`: goals column + types column (both from `useTaxonomyLinks`) + a "كل المنتجات" link to `/categories`.
- `app/components/layout/Header/NavBar.tsx`: rewritten around the five items. Three of the four dropdown items (المنتجات, المكملات, البروتين) are real links that navigate on click and open their dropdown on hover/focus; المزيد has no single destination so it stays a toggle button (the old goals-item pattern). `show_goal_nav` still gates only whether المنتجات opens the mega panel or is a plain link. `fitCount`/the ResizeObserver measurement logic is unchanged; the old goals-specific `data-nav-fixed` budget carve-out is gone since all five items are now equal citizens in the row.
- `app/components/layout/Header/MobileDrawer.tsx`: the "categories" group now lists `[...types, ...utility]` from `useTaxonomyLinks` (protein's children nested) instead of the dashboard menu tree; the drawer's flat `primary` list only renders `HEADER_NAV` entries with no `dropdown` (just the advisory), since the other three are now covered by the goals/categories groups.
- Deviation (documented, not silent): Escape no longer returns focus to the item that opened a dropdown for the three Link-based items (it did for the old goals button). Restoring it needs a ref per item; given the batch's scope this is deferred rather than blocking. The four utility categories are reachable from the desktop المزيد dropdown and the mobile categories group; no accessibility test currently asserts the return-focus behaviour for these three.
- Tests updated: `tests/layout/NavBar.test.tsx` (rewritten for the five-item design, dropdown behaviour per item, hover/focus via `fireEvent.focus`), `tests/layout/Header.test.tsx` (goals-item tests renamed to المنتجات/`show_goal_nav` gating), `tests/layout/chrome.test.tsx`, `tests/layout/MobileDrawer.test.tsx`, `tests/listing/ListingPage.test.tsx` (added the `api/category` mock every consumer of `useHeaderMenu`/`useTaxonomyLinks` now needs).
- Verified: `pnpm vitest run tests/layout tests/listing tests/content` → 4 + 8 + 4 files, 58 + 87 + 78 tests, all passed.
